## Personality

Described as disagreeable and sharp-tongued, Josie Pye is a student who lacks imagination and is regarded by peers as a cheat. Unconcerned with needing to earn a living, her primary motivation for attending college is for the sake of education itself. Additionally, she possesses notable talents for walking board fences and crafting award-winning knitted lace.

## History

Josie Pye was the last of her family to attend the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school, where she had once earned first prize for knitted lace at the exhibition. During a party at [Diana](../character/diana.md) Barry's house, she challenged [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof, an act that resulted in [Anne](../character/anne.md) falling and breaking her ankle. Later, Josie was among the group of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) students who attended the local school under Miss Stacy's guidance and eventually pursued higher education at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P1](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0001), [v1 CHAPTER XV. > — Josie Pye — [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P24](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0024)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--josie-pye.md)

Josie Pye and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) maintain a petty rivalry and mutual dislike that results in frequent unkind comments. Their ongoing antagonism leads to dangerous competitive behavior, such as when Josie dares [Anne](../character/anne.md) to walk the ridgepole of Mr. Barry's roof, causing [Anne](../character/anne.md) to fall and break her ankle. Despite their poor relationship, the two continue to attend the same school and eventually prepare for the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination together in Miss Stacy's advanced class.

- Enemy of — mutual dislike and unkind comments  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXVII. Vanity and Vexation of Spirit P40](../source/v01-c27.md#nw-v01-c27-p0040), [v3 ch.Relationships P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002)</sub>
- Rival of — exchanging dares and competing in acts of daring  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXIII. Anne Comes to Grief in an Affair of Honor P6](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0006)</sub>

### [Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/aunt-atossa--josie-pye.md)

[Aunt Atossa](../character/aunt-atossa.md) is a relative of Josie Pye, connected to her because Josie's mother is Aunt Atossa's cousin. They share an extended family network that exists in the background of the local community.

- Relative of — mother is a cousin of Aunt Atossa (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Life P41](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0041)</sub>
